A standalone link to a file in `public/` becomes a card; lines after it describe the file, and a "wip" link title marks it as in progress.

[Placeholder diagram](/navigation-model.svg)
A dummy description with *emphasis* and $F_n = F_{n-1} + F_{n-2}$, standing in for one sentence about the file.

[Placeholder icon](/favicon.svg "wip")

A link inside a sentence, such as [this icon](/favicon.svg), stays an ordinary link.
